label: Sedne si na zem
desc: Pomalu se sníží k zemi, sedne si, zakloní hlavu se zavřenýma očima, pak úsměv do kamery.
desc_en: Lowers slowly to the floor, sits down, head tipped back with eyes closed, then a smile into the camera.
style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, one slow continuous movement, calm steady tempo
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands

beats.prompt: the person shifts their weight and bends their knees, one hand reaching down toward the floor, and ends crouched, ready to sit
the person lowers themselves slowly to the floor, one hand on the ground for balance, and ends sitting with their legs folded to one side
sitting on the floor with legs folded to one side, the person settles their hands on the ground and relaxes their posture, then holds still
the person leans their head back, closes their eyes and breathes slowly, chest rising and falling, hair falling behind their shoulders, and stays there
the person opens their eyes, lifts their head and looks at the camera, a soft smile forming, and ends sitting still
